name: Riviera Maya
about: Dry season Nov–Apr is warm and comfortable; hurricane risk peaks Aug–Oct. Whale sharks gather near Isla Mujeres Jun–Sep.
overview: White-sand Caribbean beaches, cenotes, and Mayan ruins along Mexico's most developed resort coastline.
costOverview: Local transport, tacos, and cenote entry all stay cheap — inter-town taxis and resort-zone dining are where costs climb.

specialSeasons.text: Whale sharks gather to feed near Isla Mujeres and Holbox, one of the largest aggregations on Earth.
